rfc8448-clienthello.txt
  The two ClientHello records of RFC 8448, "Example Handshake Traces for
  TLS 1.3" (sections 3 and 4), copied verbatim from
  https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8448.txt. TestPeekRFC8448 and the fuzz
  seeds read them.

fuzz/FuzzPeekClientHello/openssl-3.6.4-mlkem
fuzz/FuzzPeekClientHello/curl-8.7.1-libressl-3.3.6
  Real first flights captured on 2026-09-27 by a local listener on
  127.0.0.1 that saved the first bytes each client sent:
    openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:18443 -servername h.test -alpn h2,http/1.1
      (OpenSSL 3.6.4; its default key shares include X25519MLKEM768)
    curl --resolve h.test:18443:127.0.0.1 https://h.test:18443/
      (curl 8.7.1, LibreSSL 3.3.6, macOS)
  Each is a Go fuzz corpus entry: the bytes, then where to split them
  across two reads. TestPeekCapturedHellos checks both name h.test and
  offer h2 and http/1.1.
